headline: Noon. The leak stays thin.
body: The rain on the glass has not settled into anything. Eighteen degrees under a full lid, west-southwest near fourteen, the air still close. The street has taken a sheen and kept its shape; puddles have not formed.

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: sheen on the pavement, no pools

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: noon under cloud; sun up since 7:14, still unused
